title.narrative: UNICEF Lebanon&39;s primary support to vulnerable school-aged children continued ensuring the access to quality and inclusive education. UNICEF supported children to access formal education through direct disbursement to schools through School Funds, Parent Council Funds, and payments to teachers. Additionally, UNICEF supported out-of-school children to access Multiple Flexible Pathways (MFP) through the Makani and Dirasa programmes. Both the formal education and MFP are implemented under the TREF umbrella. UNICEF also supported the MEHE and Education Sector partners to improve the quality of learning environments through teacher training and coaching as part of the National Learning Recovery Initiative.;;
